cinematic_dialogue:2:1211325001:.text: To achieve immortality, you must offer up flesh and blood.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1211325001:.male: To achieve immortality, you must offer up flesh and blood.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1211325001:.female: To achieve immortality, you must offer up flesh and blood.

say:4:1211326001:0.text: What kind of monster is that?!
say:4:1211326001:0.male: What kind of monster is that?!
say:4:1211326001:0.female: What kind of monster is that?!

say:6:1211326002:0.text: I, the esteemed chief researcher of the Dead Tide Fleet, offer you all a gift.
say:6:1211326002:0.source_cn: 死潮舰队首席研究员维珀里安，呈敬给各位的礼物。
say:6:1211326002:0.male: I, the esteemed chief researcher of the Dead Tide Fleet, offer you all a gift.
say:6:1211326002:0.female: I, the esteemed chief researcher of the Dead Tide Fleet, offer you all a gift.

say:9:1211326003:0.text: That thing he's holding... It's the same one Hodgkin used to control Nara!
say:9:1211326003:0.source_cn: 他手里那东西……之前在海上相遇时，霍德希金就是用那东西...

say:10:1211326004:0.text: Allow me to correct you. Nara is ours. Every fiber of her being, from soul to patchwork body, belongs to the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:10:1211326004:0.source_cn: 我要纠正一点，奈拉是我们的人，从灵魂到那具拼凑而成的身...

say:11:1211326005:0.text: This little one beside me now is a mere defective specimen.
say:11:1211326005:0.source_cn: 现在身边这个小家伙，只是个残次品。

say:12:1211326006:0.text: It's regrettable. Even with the sacred artifact's power, creations like Nara and Bonnie defy mass production...
say:12:1211326006:0.source_cn: 实在可惜，像奈拉和波妮这么优秀的造物，即便凭借圣器的力...

say:14:1211326008:0.text: I don't expect you to grasp the greatness of immortality. Suppress your base instincts and see reason, stop randomly howling like a wild monkey.
say:14:1211326008:0.source_cn: 我不奢求你们理解不朽的伟大之处。但至少学会压抑生物本能...
say:14:1211326008:0.male: I don't expect you to grasp the greatness of immortality. Suppress your base instincts and see reason, stop randomly howling like a wild monkey.
say:14:1211326008:0.female: I don't expect you to grasp the greatness of immortality. Suppress your base instincts and see reason, stop randomly howling like a wild monkey.

say:15:1211326009:1.text: I have very high expectations for you all. I'm short on experimental resources, and these marine creatures offer limited research potential.
say:15:1211326009:1.source_cn: 我对你们有很高的期待。实验材料严重紧缺，这些海洋生物虽...
say:15:1211326009:1.male: I have very high expectations for you all. I'm short on experimental resources, and these marine creatures offer limited research potential.
say:15:1211326009:1.female: I have very high expectations for you all. I'm short on experimental resources, and these marine creatures offer limited research potential.

say:16:1211326010:1.text: With you all here, we'll have secured valuable human bodies and two rodents. I'm quite giddy to think about what kind of tests I'll run on you all.
say:16:1211326010:1.source_cn: 感谢你们，又能取得宝贵的人类躯体了。还附赠两只啮齿动物...
say:16:1211326010:1.male: With you all here, we'll have secured valuable human bodies and two rodents. I'm quite giddy to think about what kind of tests I'll run on you all.

say:19:1211326012:0.text: Handle them gently, little one. That mage's body is invaluable for our studies.
say:19:1211326012:0.source_cn: 小家伙，别撕得太碎。那个魔法师的躯体很有研究价值……

say:19:1211326012:0.female: Handle them gently, little one. That mage's body is invaluable for our studies.

say:22:1211326013:0.source_cn: 主人，小心！那怪物要攻过来了！

choice:17:0:1.text: You think you can beat us?!
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 那要看你有没有这个本事！
choice:17:0:1.male: You think you can beat us?!
choice:17:0:1.female: You think you can beat us?!

choice:17:1:2.text: Even with your magic, you'll lose.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 有趣的魔法，但拦不住我们
choice:17:1:2.male: Even with your magic, you'll lose.
choice:17:1:2.female: Even with your magic, you'll lose.
